title: Branch-and-Bound ATSP with WASM-verified grading
summary: Identical task surface to computing_math/branch_bound_atsp (tier1/2 exact optima n=8/10, tier3 incumbent n=12, results.json with certified bounds and gaps). Sole difference: evaluate() delegates the decision core to the EvoRule WASM grading engine. Official scorer semantics (tour validity, numpy-recomputed costs, float tolerances) run in the bridge layer as auditable check-booleans; the WASM ruleset is the deterministic scoring SSOT (weights 0.40/0.35/0.25, per-check points, metadata gating). Emits ale-wasm-receipt/1 with BLAKE3-chained audit facts, independently recomputable in any browser.
